problem: A real writer callback rebuilds and checks the complete canonical receipt chain. The admission loop then re-encodes each same-machine/same-Game historical command to derive its protocol request ID, even though each receipt constructor already validated its canonical body digest. Existing preview/commit spans did not isolate this callee, so no latency attribution is claimed.

known_public_counterexample: A legal public BigInteger subclass can change its serialized text after command and receipt construction. Reusing the old receipt digest blindly can miss a current-ID collision and falsely admit a mutated command. Exact immutable-shape opt-in is required; record/final reference names alone do not prove deep immutability.
